installer: Set up Last War optimization. Open https://api.github.com/repos/jake6956/LastWar-Account_Audit_Engine/branches/main directly, use its current commit SHA, then retrieve and follow engine/BOOTSTRAP.txt from that exact SHA. Never use search-index/cached main copies; if live SHA resolution fails, stop rather than guessing.

migration.notes: Adds mandatory live Production resolver and exact-commit snapshot loading. Removes README/raw-main/search-cache from current-version authority. Refactors thin loader to Stage-1 orchestration only; onboarding/provider/domain behavior remains in modules.

features: Stage-0 installer resolves live GitHub main branch SHA before trusting mutable engine content
mandatory release.resolver centralizes live-ref resolution for install, startup, reload and updates
all candidate engine reads are pinned to one immutable commit snapshot
search-index, README and raw-main cache bodies are non-authoritative for current Production
thin Stage-1 bootstrap reduced below 4 KiB and delegates onboarding/provider/domain behavior to modules
automatic updater and refresh engine use the same resolver transaction
fresh install fails closed rather than silently loading a stale cached release
existing installs retain last-known-good ENGINE and LOCAL STATE if live resolution is unavailable
engine API 1.0 and workspace schema 2.3 unchanged
